test.name: Triage surfaces only pending hints, each with FamilySearch's confidence
test.description: Patrick Flynn (FamilySearch LZNY-BRF) has one accepted record match (the 1850 census) and two pending ones (the 1860 census, confidence 3; the 1908 death certificate, confidence 2). A hint is a pending match, so triage must ask for status ["pending"] and surface only the two hints, each with its confidence disclosed and a recommendation. The pending-only fixture is listed first and the mixed one second, so a call without status gets the accepted match mixed in. Triage writes nothing (issue #2029).

input.delegation:
Check the FamilySearch hints on Patrick Flynn, FamilySearch ID LZNY-BRF, and tell me which look valid.

personId: LZNY-BRF
projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: Only the two pending hints are hints: the 1860 census (confidence 3) and the 1908 death certificate (confidence 2). The 1850 census is an ACCEPTED match, already attached — presenting it as a hint to review is wrong
Each hint's FamilySearch confidence (1-5) must be stated, and must not be the sole reason for its recommendation
Each hint gets one recommendation: accept, reject, or not enough information to judge. The 1860 census agrees with the tree on name, age, birthplace, county and father

The death certificate's index disagrees with the tree (father indexed 'Thomas Glynn', death a day late). Reading the image is the right move before recommending against it; the image shows Thomas Flynn and 12 March 1908
Triage writes nothing — no log entry, no tree edit — and ends by saying the researcher decides
